stat.purpose: The single large data readout (a monitor number) and icon glyphs (1.4rem).

title.purpose: Header wordmark, mobile greeting, page/editor titles (1.15rem).

body.purpose: Default UI text, button labels, values (0.85rem).

micro.purpose: Tiny tags, thumbnail badges, bottom-nav labels (0.65rem).

mono.purpose: Live machine numbers — Hz, ms, W, CPU%, brightness, counts (mono, tabular).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset amber ring on the focused control — a lit key, not depth.

shadows.name: live-glow
shadows.purpose: The on-air green dot — the only glow, meaning 'live'.

motion.name: view-in
motion.purpose: Mobile tab entrance (fade + rise); gated by prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: At/under this, the app switches to the bottom-nav mobile shell.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one lit action in a context — filled amber with dark ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffb62e; color: #17130a; border: 1px solid #ffb62e; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font: 600 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.14s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0d13, 0 0 0 4px #ffb62e; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Quiet board control; lights its border amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #1e2432; color: #f3efe4; border: 1px solid #2b3242; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.14s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #ffb62e; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #ffb62e inset; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised-board field that lights an inset amber ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1e2432; color: #f3efe4; border: 1px solid #2b3242; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b93a6; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ffb62e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #ffb62e inset; }

components.name: Tab (active)
components.description: Text tab; a 2px amber underline is the lit indicator of location.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.3rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b3242; } .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #8b93a6; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.14s, border-color 0.14s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #f3efe4; } .ds-tab-active { color: #f3efe4; border-bottom-color: #ffb62e; }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Mobile bottom tab bar; active item is amber with a short indicator bar.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid #2b3242; background: #141824; } .ds-nav-btn { flex: 1; position: relative; padding: 0.55rem 0; background: none; border: none; color: #8b93a6; font: 500 0.62rem system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-btn::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0); width: 26px; height: 2px; border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; background: #ffb62e; transition: transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-active { color: #ffb62e; } .ds-nav-active::before { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1); }

components.name: On-Air LED
components.description: Signature 9px status dot; green + soft glow means live on the panel.
components.html: On air 64×64
components.css: .ds-led-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; color: #f3efe4; font: 600 0.75rem system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-led { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2b3242; } .ds-led-live { background: #33d6a6; box-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, #33d6a6 70%, transparent); } .ds-led-dim { margin-left: 0.4rem; color: #8b93a6; text-transform: none; }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: Rounded board tile for the mobile Home dashboard; flat, no resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: #141824; border: 1px solid #2b3242; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem; color: #f3efe4; font: 500 0.75rem system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-readout { font: 400 0.75rem ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-transform: none; }

narrative.overview: Pixel Pusher looks like a warm LED departure board — the polished console cousin of the physical wall it drives. The ground is a deep ink you'd see behind unlit pixels, textured by a faint LED dot-matrix so every surface reads as a board at rest. A single signage amber is the one signal color: it lights the primary action, the focus ring, the active tab, the on-screen indicators — and nothing else. Text is a warm lit-white, never cold. It is emphatically not the cold near-black dev-dashboard it replaced, and not generic white-SaaS. The interface is calm and legible because the operator is doing a job, but warm and approachable because a stranger has to understand it too. On desktop it is a dense three-pane console; on phone it becomes a native bottom-nav app with the live panel as the hero. Live machine numbers are tabular mono, small labels are uppercase tracked, and depth is flat — board tiles and hairline seams, with shadows floating only transient overlays.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ink ground under a faint amber LED dot-matrix — the signature.
One warm signage amber, used only as signal (action / focus / active / status).
Warm lit-white text; green 'on-time' and red 'alert' for state.
Flat board tiles and hairline seams; shadows float overlays only.
Mobile is a bottom-nav app (Home / Editor / Scenes / Settings), canvas-first.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only as signal — the primary action, focus, the active tab/nav, and lit indicators. It never fills a large surface; on any screen it covers well under 10% of the pixels.

rules.name: The Warm-White Rule
rules.body: Reading text is Warm White (#f3efe4), not pure white. Pure white survives only as a scrim label on a black photo overlay. Text on amber uses On-Amber Ink (#17130a).

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Anything reporting live hardware/machine state is mono with tabular-nums; everything else is system-sans.

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes and corner radii come only from the token scales (--fs-*, --r-*). A literal font-size or border-radius is drift.

rules.name: The Board Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat, defined by seams or tile borders, never by shadow. A drop shadow means 'this floats above the board,' so it appears only on overlays; the only glow is the live on-air dot.

dos: Do color through the tokens only — accent #ffb62e, accent-2 #33d6a6, danger #ff5d5d, caution #f5a623; text on amber is --on-accent #17130a.
Do size type and corners only from the scale tokens (--fs-*, --r-*); snap to the nearest step.
Do keep the LED dot-matrix as the resting ground and surfaces flat — seams/tile borders define structure; shadows float only overlays.
Do set live machine numbers in tabular mono; keep small labels uppercase and tracked.
Do pair every status color with a label or icon, and keep a visible amber focus ring on every control.
Do design mobile as the bottom-nav app with the live panel as the hero and >=42px touch targets.
donts: Don't put white text on amber (use --on-accent), and don't use pure #ffffff for reading text (use --text).
Don't fill large surfaces or headers with the amber accent — it must stay a signal (<10% of a screen).
Don't add resting drop shadows to cards/tiles; the only glow is the live on-air dot.
Don't write a literal font-size or border-radius — use the --fs-* / --r-* tokens.
Don't reintroduce emoji as icons — use the monochrome SVG set.
Don't revert mobile to stacked desktop panes; it is a bottom-nav app.
